findings.evidence: ## Hosts restates which skill dirs Claude Code, opencode, pi, Codex and Cursor already read, then admits two of those reads are not live-verified.
findings.fix: Drop the host catalog. Keep only the six-root lookup table the caller must walk.

findings.evidence: ## Call it is two sentences that point at reference.md, so the procedure pattern has a gap between calling and reading the result.
findings.fix: State the screen-versus-ladder choice and the one required read in that section, in the order the agent acts.

findings.evidence: The NEVER list names the traps, but the measured reasons (pricing option flipped 0.46 to 0.86; 50% of confident Laya answers right) live only in reference.md and backends/laya.md.
findings.fix: Put one measured reason on the batching NEVER and on the verdict NEVER.

findings.evidence: The description names noul, choice, score, Laya and TypeSafe, but not ladder, consent grant, or the probe.
findings.fix: Use when a fast, cheap typed judgment beats a full reasoning pass: a yes/no (noul), a pick among named options (choice), a rubric score, or screening evidence, through the shared System One client (scripts/jev_review.py ladder or --probe) on Laya (local) or TypeSafe (remote; consent grant required before anything leaves the machine). Advisory only: needs_fallback means you decide that item yourself, and no answer is a verdict or gate. Not for building TypeSafe into an app (typesafe-ai) or for editing code.

findings.evidence: One 245-line reference.md holds request shape, status, consent, settings, records, calibration, env, errors, the capability matrix and the lookup, while SKILL.md only says read reference.md before choice, score or receipt.
findings.fix: Split those topics into separately named files and name the condition that loads each one; do not load the rest for a routine call.

findings.evidence: consent_required_for_remote says ask the user; on yes grant/export, retry, while SKILL.md says run consent grant and JEV_ALLOW_REMOTE never opens an off-loopback Laya.
findings.fix: Name consent grant as the only default, and say the session export applies only to a keyed remote row whose host a project file cannot move.

findings.evidence: eval_cases.py takes --record and --calibrate by scanning sys.argv and has no --help; the listed tests cover jev_review.py, not this script's usage.
findings.fix: Give eval_cases.py an argparse --help with examples, and add one smoke test that runs --help and a dry calibration path.

findings.evidence: Read the result says match ids to answers or errors, but an ok screen result nests answers under answers and item failures under errors, so an agent can look for the id at the top level.
findings.fix: State that an ok screen object has answers and errors keyed by item id, and give the one-item lookup.
